verses.text: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

segments.text: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples;
Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.text: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.

segments.text: For Jehovah Most High is terrible;
He is a great King over all the earth.

verses.text: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.

segments.text: He subdueth peoples under us,
And nations under our feet.

verses.text: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. [Selah

segments.text: He chooseth our inheritance for us,

verses.text: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

segments.text: God is gone up with a shout,
Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

segments.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises:
Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.text: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.

segments.text: For God is the King of all the earth:
Sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.text: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.

segments.text: God reigneth over the nations:

verses.text: The princes of the peoples are gathered together To be the people of the God of Abraham; For the shields of the earth belong unto God: He is greatly exalted.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
